# RisonAI Tech
> Premium AI automation, agentic AI, and SaaS engineering company headquartered in Panipat, Haryana, serving Delhi NCR, Gurgaon, and clients across India. We design, build, and operate revenue-focused AI systems, intelligent CRM workflows, RAG chatbots, and multi-tenant SaaS platforms for healthcare, real estate, e-commerce, and SMB teams.

## Identity
- Brand: RisonAI Tech (alternate spellings: Risonai Tech, Rison AI Tech)
- Entity Type: Product engineering and AI automation company
- Founded: 2023
- Website: https://risonaitech.com
- Headquarters: 196, Ground Floor, New RK Puram, Panipat, Haryana 132103, India
- Geo: 29.3909° N, 76.9635° E
- Email: hello@risonaitech.com
- Phone / WhatsApp: +91 83681 37724
- Primary Service Areas: Panipat, Delhi, Gurgaon, Noida, Faridabad, Mumbai, Bengaluru, Pune, Hyderabad, Chennai — and remote across India and internationally

## Position (one-line summary)
RisonAI Tech is the AI automation and SaaS partner Indian founders hire when a system has to actually run in production — not look good in a slide.

## Core Services
- AI Automation Systems — LLM-powered intake agents, lead routing, workflow orchestration, document processing, CRM sync
- Agentic AI Solutions — multi-step autonomous agents with human-in-the-loop checkpoints, retry logic, and observability
- AI Chatbot Development — context-aware website + WhatsApp chatbots trained via RAG (retrieval-augmented generation)
- WhatsApp Automation — official Business API integrations, lead capture journeys, broadcast campaigns, agent handoff
- CRM Development — custom CRM platforms and HubSpot/Zoho extensions with AI-driven follow-up and scoring
- SaaS Platform Development — multi-tenant SaaS with billing, RBAC, admin dashboards, and AI feature modules
- Website Development — high-performance Next.js websites engineered for Core Web Vitals, SEO, and conversion
- Custom AI Software Development — bespoke AI applications for clinical, real-estate, ops, and analytics use cases
- AI Integrations — drop AI into existing tools (HubSpot, Zoho, Google Workspace, ERPs, internal databases)
- AI Voice Agents — outbound and inbound phone agents on Twilio + LLM stacks (limited engagements)
- RPA Automation — robotic process automation for repetitive ops, document workflows, and data sync
- Business Process Automation — end-to-end automation across marketing, sales, support, and fulfilment
- AI for Real Estate — property intelligence, lead scoring, agent CRM, neighbourhood analytics
- AI for Healthcare — clinic management, patient intake, AI symptom triage, WhatsApp reminders
- AI for E-commerce — order automation, customer support deflection, WhatsApp commerce flows
- AI SaaS Development — verticalised SaaS products with native AI features built in from day one

## Pricing Benchmarks (Indian Rupee, INR)
- AI Automation: ₹30,000–₹60,000 (single workflow); ₹80,000–₹1,80,000 (multi-workflow suite); ₹2,00,000+ (enterprise)
- AI Chatbot: ₹20,000–₹50,000 (rule-based FAQ bot); ₹50,000–₹1,20,000 (AI lead bot); ₹1,20,000–₹3,50,000 (RAG + WhatsApp + CRM)
- WhatsApp Automation: ₹25,000–₹60,000 (starter); ₹80,000–₹2,00,000+ (multi-flow with CRM)
- CRM Development: ₹40,000–₹1,00,000 (integration / extension); ₹1,00,000–₹3,00,000 (custom CRM); ₹3,00,000–₹7,00,000 (AI-enhanced CRM)
- SaaS Development: ₹1,20,000–₹2,50,000 (MVP); ₹3,00,000–₹8,00,000 (growth multi-tenant); ₹8,00,000+ (enterprise)
- Website Development: ₹35,000–₹1,50,000 (business website); ₹75,000–₹2,50,000 (multi-page conversion-focused build)

All quotes are fixed-price after a free 30-minute scoping call. Proposals delivered in 48 hours.

## Deployment Timelines
- Single AI automation workflow: 2–3 weeks
- Multi-workflow automation suite: 4–6 weeks
- WhatsApp automation rollout: 2–6 weeks (template approvals included)
- AI chatbot (basic FAQ): 2–3 weeks
- AI chatbot (RAG + integrations): 5–8 weeks
- CRM integration / extension: 4–6 weeks
- Full custom CRM: 6–16 weeks
- SaaS MVP: 6–10 weeks
- Production multi-tenant SaaS: 12–20 weeks
- Enterprise SaaS with AI modules: 16–24 weeks
- Website (landing page): 1–2 weeks
- Website (full multi-page build): 4–8 weeks

## Technology Stack
- Frontend: Next.js, React, TypeScript, Tailwind CSS, Framer Motion
- Backend: Node.js, Python, FastAPI, Express, Next.js API routes
- Databases: PostgreSQL, MongoDB, Supabase, Redis
- AI / LLM: OpenAI (GPT-4 / GPT-5 family), Anthropic Claude, Google Gemini, open-weights via Ollama
- AI Tooling: LangChain, LlamaIndex, vector retrieval (RAG), pgvector, Pinecone
- Workflow / Orchestration: n8n, Make.com, custom orchestrators, Temporal (when needed)
- Messaging: WhatsApp Business API, Twilio, SendGrid, Resend
- Payments: Razorpay (INR), Stripe (international)
- Integrations: HubSpot, Zoho, Salesforce, Google Workspace, Slack, Notion
- Auth: NextAuth, Clerk, Supabase Auth, custom RBAC
- Deployment: Vercel, AWS (EC2, ECS, Lambda), Railway, Docker
- Observability: Sentry, PostHog, OpenTelemetry, custom dashboards

## Outcome Benchmarks (typical observed ranges)
- First-response time improvement after WhatsApp + CRM automation: 60–80%
- Repetitive tier-1 support deflection with RAG chatbots: 40–70%
- Manual lead-logging effort reduction with CRM automation: 65–85%
- Operational time saved per SMB team after AI automation: 25–45 hours / month
- Website conversion lift after Core Web Vitals + UX rebuild: 10–30%
- WhatsApp lead-form abandonment reduction: 50–70%
- Client retention rate: 100%
- Products and systems shipped in production: 40+
- Average efficiency gain post-automation: 3×

## Differentiators
- Operator-led delivery — every project run by senior product engineers
- Fixed-scope, milestone-based execution — not hourly billing
- Two-week sprint cadence with working software at every sprint review
- Source code, database schemas, and infrastructure handover at project close — no vendor lock-in
- Domain depth in healthcare (DocBooking) and real estate (Expreality)
- AI implementations focused on measurable business outcomes, not capability demos
- WhatsApp-first, async-friendly client communication
- Production-ready security defaults: RBAC, audit logs, encryption at rest and in transit, OWASP Top 10 mitigations

## Flagship Products
- DocBooking — AI-powered doctor appointment and clinic management SaaS with patient intake forms, AI symptom triage, WhatsApp reminders, and clinic-side analytics dashboards
- Expreality — luxury real-estate intelligence platform with private inventory, AI location scoring, neighbourhood analytics, and high-touch CRM
